world.title: 看不见的磁力线
world.posterHook: 拖动磁铁，青色与琥珀色的场线重新组织；铁屑像微型指南针，自己排成花纹。
world.posterSource: Canvas 2D · 磁偶极场线 · 本地构建
world.question: 铁屑为什么会自己排成花纹？
world.hook: 拖动条形磁铁，看偶极场线与铁屑取向如何同时改写整片空间的纹理。
world.payoff: 磁偶极场在外部从 N 指向 S 并在内部闭合。铁屑沿局部 B 排列，勾出看不见的场；移动磁铁时，图案不是贴纸平移，而是整片场的重新组织。

en.title: Invisible magnetic lines
en.posterTitle: Iron filings trace the shape of a magnetic field
en.posterHook: Drag a magnet and cyan–amber field lines reorganize; iron filings act like tiny compasses and line themselves into a pattern.
en.posterSource: Canvas 2D · Magnetic dipole field lines · Local build
en.question: Why do iron filings arrange themselves into patterns?
en.hook: Drag a bar magnet and watch dipole field lines and iron-filing orientation rewrite the texture of the whole plane.
en.payoff: Outside a dipole, field lines run from N toward S and close inside the magnet. Filings align with local B and sketch the invisible field; when the magnet moves, the pattern reorganizes—it does not slide like a sticker.
